papers.title: TCSP3.0: Template-Based Crystal Structure Prediction with Coefficient-Preserving Element Substitution and Structural Diversity
papers.translated_title: TCSP3.0：基于模板的晶体结构预测，采用系数保持的元素替换与结构多样性
papers.author: Ying Feng
papers.summary: Template-based crystal structure prediction (CSP) transfers a known crystal structure to a new composition by element substitution, so its accuracy depends on retrieving suitable templates, mapping elements and ranking the resulting candidates correctly. Auditing the original TCSP2.0 implementation on the T180 benchmark, we found that 469 of its 2,347 selected structures (20%) have the wrong composition, caused by element mappings that ignore stoichiometric coefficients and by sequential text substitution that cascades or corrupts element symbols. We propose TCSP3.0, which enforces coefficient-preserving mappings, substitutes species simultaneously on parsed structures and validates every candidate's composition and cell. It further adds periodic-number retrieval, soft oxidation-state evidence, radius-compatibility scoring, structural deduplication, and ORB-v3 machine-learning-potential relaxation and energy ranking of its candidates, as used by deep generative CSP baselines. TCSP3.0 achieves Top-1 and Top-20 match rates of 72.2% and 90.6% on T180, compared with 28.3% and 45.6% for TCSP2.0, and a Top-20 match rate of 74.0% on a new 800-target benchmark (T800). On T180 it also outperforms PNcsp+ and deep generative models CrystalFlow and MaskGXT (Top-1 72.2% versus at most 63.9%). Even without relaxation, TCSP3.0 reaches 67.8% at Top-1 and 90.6% at Top-20 in a median of 28 s per target on two CPU cores, about ten times faster than CrystalFlow. Paired ten-arm ablations on T180 and T800 show that most of the improvement comes from the correctness fixes; structural deduplication significantly improves the Top-5 match rate, embedding-based retrieval is required for coverage, and the remaining scoring features have small or null effects.
papers.translated_summary: 基于模板的晶体结构预测（CSP）通过元素替换将已知晶体结构迁移到新组分，因此其精度取决于能否检索到合适的模板、正确映射元素并对候选结构进行合理排序。在T180基准上审计原始TCSP2.0实现时，我们发现其选出的2347个结构中有469个（20%）组分错误，原因在于元素映射忽略了化学计量系数，以及顺序文本替换导致元素符号级联或损坏。我们提出TCSP3.0，它强制采用保持系数的映射，在解析后的结构上同时替换物种，并验证每个候选的组分和晶胞。它进一步增加了周期序数检索、软氧化态证据、半径兼容性评分、结构去重，以及ORB-v3机器学习势弛豫和候选能量排序，与深度生成CSP基线所用方法一致。TCSP3.0在T180上达到72.2%的Top-1和90.6%的Top-20匹配率，而TCSP2.0分别为28.3%和45.6%；在全新的800目标基准（T800）上Top-20匹配率为74.0%。在T180上它还优于PNcsp+和深度生成模型CrystalFlow与MaskGXT（Top-1为72.2%对最高63.9%）。即使不做弛豫，TCSP3.0在两个CPU核心上以每个目标中位数28秒达到Top-1 67.8%和Top-20 90.6%，比CrystalFlow快约十倍。在T180和T800上进行的配对十臂消融实验表明，大部分提升来自正确性修复；结构去重显著提升Top-5匹配率，基于嵌入的检索是覆盖所必需的，其余评分特征影响很小或没有影响。

papers.title: Explaining Navigation Decisions: Stage-Aware Visual Attribution for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.translated_title: 解释导航决策：面向视觉语言导航的阶段感知视觉归因
papers.author: Yiyuan Yao
papers.summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly enable robots to follow language instructions, understanding their navigation decisions becomes important for reliable deployment. Existing explainability methods overlook a key challenge in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN): evidence for the current action may be distributed across historical and current observations and associated with different instruction stages. We identify instruction-stage insensitivity, where existing methods produce similar explanations despite changes across different navigation stages. To address this issue, we propose a stage-aware attribution framework for VLN. We first construct action-conditioned temporal instruction--visual attributions across observations. These attributions are projected into instruction space to estimate stage associations, which guide the aggregation of relevant historical evidence for refining the current explanation. An instruction-guided spatial filter further suppresses isolated responses while preserving compact, instruction-relevant regions. Experiments across multiple VLN policies and benchmarks show improved attribution quality over existing methods. We further demonstrate that our method acts as a diagnostic tool for analyzing failure cases, and validate its applicability to real-world navigation on a Unitree G1 robot.
papers.translated_summary: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）日益使机器人能够遵循语言指令，理解其导航决策对于可靠部署变得十分重要。现有可解释性方法忽视了视觉语言导航（VLN）中的一个关键挑战：当前动作的证据可能分布在历史观测与当前观测中，并与不同的指令阶段相关联。我们识别出指令阶段不敏感性问题，即现有方法在不同导航阶段发生变化时仍产生相似的解释。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种面向VLN的阶段感知归因框架。我们首先构建跨观测的、以动作为条件的时间指令—视觉归因。这些归因被投影到指令空间以估计阶段关联，进而引导相关历史证据的聚合，以细化当前解释。指令引导的空间滤波器进一步抑制孤立响应，同时保留紧凑的、与指令相关的区域。在多种VLN策略和基准上的实验表明，归因质量优于现有方法。我们进一步证明，我们的方法可作为分析失败案例的诊断工具，并在Unitree G1机器人上验证了其在实际导航中的适用性。

papers.title: When Does GEPA Merge Help? A Mechanism-Level Diagnostic
papers.translated_title: GEPA合并在何时有帮助？一项机制层面的诊断
papers.author: Chong Zhao
papers.summary: GEPA is among the strongest reflective prompt optimizers for language-model programs, but its system-aware merge operator is unstable across models: merge improves gpt-4.1-mini on average while degrading Qwen3-8B, an asymmetry noted but left unexplained by the GEPA paper. We investigate this instability across five datasets and two models. Our nine-configuration sweep over merge timing and merge operator shows that merge can improve both models when configured appropriately. This suggests that merge instability is better explained by configuration sensitivity than by an inherent flaw in the merge operator. We then test whether prompt-level features predict GEPA's merge-accept decisions and find that they do not, ruling out static-feature gating. As a proof of concept, a behavior-based probe built from these diagnostics avoids large merge failures in our multi-seed runs by abstaining on high-risk tasks, although it does not consistently outperform NoMerge. Code is available as GEPA-MergeProbe at https://github.com/ChongZZZZ/GEPA_MERGE .
papers.translated_summary: GEPA 是语言模型程序最强的反思式提示优化器之一，但其系统感知合并算子在跨模型时表现不稳定：合并平均能提升 gpt-4.1-mini，却会降低 Qwen3-8B 的性能，GEPA 论文注意到了这种不对称性但未作解释。我们在五个数据集和两个模型上研究了这种不稳定性。我们针对合并时机与合并算子进行的九配置扫描表明，在配置得当时，合并可以同时提升两个模型。这表明合并的不稳定性更适合用配置敏感性来解释，而非合并算子本身的固有缺陷。随后我们检验了提示层面的特征能否预测 GEPA 的合并接受决策，发现并不能，从而排除了静态特征门控。作为概念验证，基于这些诊断构建的行为探针在我们的多种子运行中通过对高风险任务弃权，避免了严重的合并失败，尽管它并未始终优于 NoMerge。代码以 GEPA-MergeProbe 形式发布于 https://github.com/ChongZZZZ/GEPA_MERGE 。

papers.title: The Symmetry of Differential Neural Tangent Kernel under the Orthogonal Group
papers.translated_title: 正交群下微分神经正切核的对称性
papers.author: Bangti Jin
papers.summary: The differential neural tangent kernel (DNTK) is a tool for analyzing the training dynamics of overparameterized physics informed neural networks. In this work, we investigate the symmetry of the infinite DNTK under an orthogonal group, for two layer and deep neural networks separately, based on the explicit expression of the DNTK and recursive formula, respectively. The results are for all activations with or without a bias term, and shed insight into the structure of the infinite width DNTK. Then we prove that the integral operators over the unit sphere induced by operators from the same group orbit share the spectrum, and their reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces differ only by an orthogonal transformation, and that the operator fixed DNTK exhibits zonal symmetry on the unit sphere for symmetric operators. Thus the eigenvalue decay rate of the associated integral operator can be derived for shallow networks with RePU activation and zero bias initialization.
papers.translated_summary: 微分神经正切核（DNTK）是分析过参数化物理信息神经网络训练动力学的工具。本文分别基于DNTK的显式表达式和递推公式，研究了两层和深层神经网络在正交群下无限DNTK的对称性。所得结果适用于带或不带偏置项的所有激活函数，并有助于深入理解无限宽度DNTK的结构。随后我们证明，由同一群轨道上的算子诱导的单位球面上的积分算子具有相同的谱，其再生核希尔伯特空间仅相差一个正交变换，并且对于对称算子，算子固定的DNTK在单位球面上表现出纬向对称性。因此，对于采用RePU激活和零偏置初始化的浅层网络，可以推导出相关积分算子的特征值衰减率。

papers.title: Deep Scientific Reasoning under Physical Constraints: Structure-Aware Spectrum Prediction
papers.translated_title: 物理约束下的深度科学推理：结构感知频谱预测
papers.author: Yingheng Wang
papers.summary: Structured scientific spectra encode rich physical information while obeying hard constraints, such as conservation laws and characteristic spectral geometry. Accurate prediction of these spectra is central to materials discovery, yet existing methods often treat them as unconstrained sequences and therefore fail to enforce the underlying physical structure. Taking electronic density of states (eDOS) as the prototypical example, we introduce DeepSciReasoner, a general paradigm for predicting scientific spectra under physical constraints. The framework combines structure-aware spectrum decoding with constraint-preserving physical reasoning, allowing predictions to capture rich spectral structure while respecting the underlying physics. We evaluate DeepSciReasoner on eDOS, phonon density of states (phDOS), X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES), and Raman spectra, where it substantially improves prediction accuracy while maintaining physical consistency. These results establish DeepSciReasoner as a reusable blueprint for structured scientific spectrum prediction under hard physical constraints.
papers.translated_summary: 结构化科学谱编码了丰富的物理信息，同时遵循守恒定律和特征谱几何等硬约束。准确预测这些谱对于材料发现至关重要，然而现有方法往往将其视为无约束序列，因而无法施加潜在的物理结构。以电子态密度（eDOS）为典型示例，我们引入了DeepSciReasoner，一种在物理约束下预测科学谱的通用范式。该框架将结构感知的谱解码与保持约束的物理推理相结合，使预测能够捕捉丰富的谱结构，同时遵循潜在的物理规律。我们在eDOS、声子态密度（phDOS）、X射线吸收近边结构（XANES）和拉曼光谱上评估了DeepSciReasoner，其在保持物理一致性的同时显著提高了预测精度。这些结果确立了DeepSciReasoner作为硬物理约束下结构化科学谱预测的可复用蓝图。

papers.title: BriLLM-MetaPred: A Representation-Prediction Unity Language Model with Adaptive Self-Measurement
papers.translated_title: BriLLM-MetaPred：一种具有自适应自测量的表示-预测统一语言模型
papers.author: Junyuan Liu
papers.summary: We present BriLLM-MetaPred, the first engineering implementation of the MetaPred machine-learning framework established by a mathematical theory of AGI, instantiated for language modeling. The theory argues that MetaPred is both necessary and sufficient as a machine-learning primitive for general cognition. Taking this theoretical conclusion as a design premise, we report an implementation of the primitive for language modeling. A single continuously evolving dynamical state serves as both the context representation and the state from which predictions are read out. Continuous measurement of its own state reduces finite-depth inconsistency, maintains internal consistency, and provides an endogenous dynamical self-supervision signal in fixed-point form. The single dynamical state of MetaPred intrinsically couples training and inference. MetaPred therefore exhibits symmetry across almost all key elements of machine learning, an intuitive and observable property of the mathematical optimum over the space of all machine-learning paradigms. BriLLM-MetaPred is neither another recurrent language model nor an extension of BriLLM. It provides a bridge between two prior contributions: the construction and motivation of the MetaPred primitive provided by AGI theory, and the SiFu learning paradigm provided by BriLLM (Zhao et al., 2025). The latter's node-signal-flow design enables the primitive to run on available software and hardware accelerators. Our implementation of BriLLM-MetaPred achieves predictive performance comparable to a GPT baseline of the same size. This provides initial evidence for the engineering feasibility of the MetaPred framework established by the mathematical theory of AGI. MetaPred is the first machine-learning paradigm derived entirely from mathematical theory rather than assembled and incrementally improved through human design---and perhaps the last such paradigm.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出 BriLLM-MetaPred，这是由 AGI 数学理论所建立的 MetaPred 机器学习框架的首次工程实现，并针对语言建模进行了实例化。该理论认为，MetaPred 作为通用认知的机器学习原语，既是必要的也是充分的。我们以这一理论结论作为设计前提，报告了该原语在语言建模中的一种实现。一个单一的、持续演化的动力学状态同时充当上下文表示以及从中读出预测的状态。对其自身状态的连续测量减少了有限深度不一致性，维持了内部一致性，并以不动点形式提供了一种内生的动力学自监督信号。MetaPred 的单一动力学状态内在地耦合了训练与推理。因此，MetaPred 在机器学习的几乎所有关键要素上表现出对称性，这是关于所有机器学习范式空间上数学最优解的一种直观且可观测的性质。BriLLM-MetaPred 既不是另一种循环语言模型，也不是 BriLLM 的扩展。它在两项先前贡献之间提供了桥梁：AGI 理论所提供的 MetaPred 原语的构造与动机，以及 BriLLM（Zhao 等，2025）所提供的 SiFu 学习范式。后者的节点信号流设计使该原语能够在可用的软件和硬件加速器上运行。我们对 BriLLM-MetaPred 的实现达到了与同等规模 GPT 基线相当的预测性能。这为 AGI 数学理论所建立的 MetaPred 框架的工程可行性提供了初步证据。MetaPred 是第一个完全源自数学理论、而非通过人工设计组装并逐步改进而来的机器学习范式——或许也是最后一个这样的范式。

papers.title: The Information Geometry of Representation Formation
papers.translated_title: 表示形成的信息几何
papers.author: Sanjukta Krishnagopal
papers.summary: Most analyses of neural representations focus on trained endpoints, leaving the process by which internal structure forms comparatively unmeasured. We instead treat representation formation itself as an object of study, asking whether the path a representation takes through training reveals information that its endpoint does not. We formalize this idea by viewing representation learning as a geometric trajectory, using Bures geometry to measure movement through representation space and quantum Fisher information to characterize local sensitivity to input factors. We find that learning concentrates local sensitivity on task-relevant factors, and that changing only the prediction target reorganizes this geometry around the corresponding visual factor. More strikingly, representation trajectories become systematically less direct as the learned computation requires higher-order interactions among input factors. This effect persists under matched-performance and training-duration controls and transfers from synthetic vector inputs to residual CNNs on rendered and natural images. Importantly, formation history contains predictive information about the stability of the learned representation: controlling for interaction order, path tortuosity predicts its subsequent drift under continued training and sensitivity to parameter perturbations, whereas endpoint displacement does not. Finally, representation-aware optimization lets us actively shape these trajectories, showing that formation geometry is not only measurable but actionable. Together, these results establish representation formation as a new source of information about learning: its geometry reveals properties of the computation being constructed, predicts subsequent representational stability, and provides a target for intervention during optimization.
papers.translated_summary: 大多数关于神经表征的分析都聚焦于训练终点，而对内部结构形成的过程则相对缺乏测量。我们转而将表征形成本身作为研究对象，追问表征在训练中所经过的路径是否揭示了其终点所不包含的信息。我们通过将表征学习视为几何轨迹来形式化这一想法，使用Bures几何来测量在表征空间中的移动，并使用量子Fisher信息来刻画对输入因素的局部敏感性。我们发现，学习将局部敏感性集中于任务相关因素，而仅改变预测目标就会使这一几何围绕相应的视觉因素重新组织。更引人注目的是，当所学计算需要输入因素之间更高阶的交互时，表征轨迹会系统性地变得不那么直接。这一效应在匹配性能和训练时长的控制下依然存在，并从合成向量输入迁移到渲染图像和自然图像上的残差CNN。重要的是，形成历史包含关于所学表征稳定性的预测信息：在控制交互阶数的情况下，路径曲折度预测其在持续训练下的后续漂移以及对参数扰动的敏感性，而终点位移则不能。最后，表征感知的优化使我们能够主动塑造这些轨迹，表明形成几何不仅可测量而且可操作。总之，这些结果将表征形成确立为关于学习的一种新信息来源：其几何揭示了正在构建的计算的性质，预测了后续的表征稳定性，并为优化过程中的干预提供了目标。

papers.title: The Patient Is Always Right? Evaluating Sycophancy in Medical Diagnosis with Graded Patient Beliefs
papers.translated_title: 病人总是对的吗？在带有分级病人信念的医学诊断中评估谄媚倾向
papers.author: Viswonathan Manoranjan
papers.summary: More people are seeking out general-purpose AI models for medical advice, including diagnosis. Yet, AI models are susceptible to sycophancy, like validating users' beliefs even when they are untrue, which could lead to false positive diagnoses. Here, we evaluate how nine AI models change their diagnostic decision when a patient presents a belief that they have a specific (but incorrect) medical condition. We vary how close the user belief is to the clinical evidence presented. Models sycophantically adopt the patient's belief on average 23.2\% of the time---sometimes even when the patient proposes a fictional, made-up condition. We also varied different personas, including a Rare Disease Claimer that got models to accept their belief 43.0\% of the time. Additional analyses find that medical fine-tuning and model scale makes models less susceptible to changing their diagnoses. Sycophantic bias in medical diagnosis raises implications for safety, especially as more people are using AI for health support.
papers.translated_summary: 越来越多的人寻求通用人工智能模型提供医疗建议，包括诊断。然而，人工智能模型容易产生谄媚倾向，例如即使使用者的信念不真实也会予以认可，这可能导致假阳性诊断。在此，我们评估了九个AI模型在患者表达自己患有某种特定（但不正确）疾病信念时，其诊断决策会如何变化。我们改变了使用者信念与所呈现临床证据之间的接近程度。模型平均有23.2%的时间会谄媚地采纳患者的信念——有时甚至是在患者提出虚构、编造的病症时。我们还测试了不同的人物角色，包括“罕见病声称者”，该角色使模型有43.0%的时间接受其信念。进一步分析发现，医学微调 and 模型规模会使模型更不容易改变其诊断。医学诊断中的谄媚偏差对安全性提出了重要警示，尤其是随着越来越多的人使用人工智能获取健康支持。

papers.title: Reversible Pseudonymisation of Documents Sent to External LLMs: an Open Bilingual Benchmark and an Engine
papers.translated_title: 发送至外部大型语言模型文档的可逆假名化：一个开放的双语基准与引擎
papers.author: Vladimir Beskorovainyi
papers.summary: Professionals send working documents to external large language models. A common safeguard is reversible pseudonymisation: personal data are replaced with placeholders before the request and restored locally in the answer. We present an open benchmark of five existing open tools and a regular-expression baseline on Russian and UK English, and an open engine built on the two strongest tools. The benchmark excludes each tool's own authors' dataset from its verdict, compares the engine with each tool on identical datasets for detection, reports masking precision, and tests on a held-out set of synthetic documents whose files, hashes, decision rules, run plan and stopping rule were published before any run. Two local LLMs test whether placeholders survive. All evaluation data are synthetic, and the benchmark was run by the author of the engine; code, data, predictions and raw answers are released. On external datasets no existing tool meets all predefined thresholds: in UK English the identifier and leak thresholds are not met, in Russian the identifier threshold is borderline. On the last held-out set of 1,000 documents per language, the best existing tools leave a whole value visible in 61% (Russian) and 58% (UK) of documents. On these documents, from the generator it was developed on, the engine does so in 0.3% [0.1; 0.9] and 0.2% [0.1; 0.7], leaves any part of a value visible in 0.8% and 0.2%, and meets all detection thresholds in both languages. In UK English it also restores at least 99% of its placeholders after 760 answers. In Russian it restores only 94.6% [93.6; 95.6] of name placeholders, against a 99% threshold, mainly because the inflection it borrows from pii-guard produces wrong surname forms. The engine was developed over six earlier held-out sets from the same generator; real documents were not tested.
papers.translated_summary: 专业人员会将工作文档发送至外部大型语言模型。常见的防护措施是可逆假名化：在请求前将个人数据替换为占位符，并在收到回答后在本地恢复。我们提出了一个开放基准，涵盖五个现有开源工具和一个正则表达式基线，针对俄语和英式英语，并提出了一个基于两个最强工具构建的开放引擎。该基准在裁决时将每个工具自身作者的数据集排除在外，在相同数据集上比较引擎与各工具在检测方面的表现，报告掩蔽精确率，并在一组留出的合成文档上进行测试，这些文档的文件、哈希、决策规则、运行计划和停止规则均在任何运行之前公布。两个本地大型语言模型测试占位符是否存活。所有评估数据均为合成数据，且基准由引擎作者运行；代码、数据、预测和原始回答均已发布。在外部数据集上，没有现有工具满足所有预定义阈值：在英式英语中，标识符和泄漏阈值未满足；在俄语中，标识符阈值处于临界状态。在最后留出的每种语言1,000份文档集上，最佳现有工具在61%（俄语）和58%（英式英语）的文档中留下完整值可见。在这些文档上，引擎在其开发所基于的生成器上，该比例为0.3% [0.1; 0.9]和0.2% [0.1; 0.7]，任何部分值可见的比例为0.8%和0.2%，并在两种语言中满足所有检测阈值。在英式英语中，它在760个回答后仍能恢复至少99%的占位符。在俄语中，它仅恢复94.6% [93.6; 95.6]的姓名占位符，低于99%的阈值，主要原因是它从pii-guard借用的屈折变化产生了错误的姓氏形式。该引擎是在来自同一生成器的六个早期留出集上开发的；真实文档未进行测试。

papers.title: Cross-User Adaptation for sEMG Gesture Recognition via Continual Learning
papers.translated_title: 基于持续学习的sEMG手势识别跨用户适配
papers.author: Aran Ramakrishnan
papers.summary: Prosthetic and assistive interfaces increasingly depend on decoding hand gestures from surface electromyography (sEMG). Because the signal is shaped by person-specific factors, the recurrent neural networks (RNNs) commonly used to model these temporal streams must adapt to new wearers and new gesture classes after deployment. Continual learning (CL) enables this adaptation without retraining from scratch, yet applying it to recurrent sEMG models is not straightforward. Standard recurrent training practices can destabilize learning, and which CL strategy holds up under realistic cross-user drift is unestablished. We evaluate three representative CL strategies under domain- and class-incremental drift on NinaPro DB1, and find experience replay to outperform elastic weight consolidation (EWC) and naive fine-tuning. It reaches 83.3% final accuracy for class-incremental drift while limiting forgetting to 1.8-5.8% accuracy drop, as against 16.2-28.5% for EWC and naive training. We further show these models must be trained on shuffled, independently-windowed segments. Streaming windows in temporal order collapses the network into predicting a single dominant gesture, while a shuffled, stateless regime trains stably. Finally, hand-crafted time-domain features raise per-task accuracy by up to about 40% over raw signals, but only replay preserves that gain under class-incremental drift.
papers.translated_summary: 假肢与辅助接口日益依赖从表面肌电信号(sEMG)中解码手势。由于该信号受个体特异性因素影响，常用于建模这些时间序列的循环神经网络(RNN)必须在部署后适应新的佩戴者和新的手势类别。持续学习(CL)使这种适应无需从头重新训练，但将其应用于循环sEMG模型并非易事。标准的循环训练实践可能使学习不稳定，且在真实的跨用户漂移下哪种CL策略能够奏效尚未确定。我们在NinaPro DB1上评估了三种代表性CL策略在域增量与类增量漂移下的表现，发现经验回放优于弹性权重巩固(EWC)和朴素微调。在类增量漂移下，它达到83.3%的最终准确率，同时将遗忘限制在1.8-5.8%的准确率下降，而EWC和朴素训练则为16.2-28.5%。我们进一步表明，这些模型必须在打乱的、独立分窗的片段上训练。按时间顺序的流式窗口会使网络崩溃为预测单一主导手势，而打乱的、无状态的方式则能稳定训练。最后，手工设计的时间域特征相比原始信号将每任务准确率提升最多约40%，但只有回放能在类增量漂移下保持这一增益。

papers.title: Conflicts and coalitions among selfish toxin-antidote elements shape the evolution of hyperdivergent haplotypes
papers.translated_title: 自私的毒素-解毒剂元件之间的冲突与联盟塑造了高度分化单倍型的演化
papers.author: Koreshova, A.
papers.summary: Genetic conflict drives evolutionary innovation, yet most research has focused on arms races between selfish elements and their hosts. A second layer-competition among selfish elements-remains largely unexplored. Here, we uncover such a conflict between two antagonistic toxin-antidote elements (TAs), loki-1/sgyn-1 and thor-1/sif-1, in Caenorhabditis tropicalis. Each toxin, LOKI-1 or THOR-1, selectively kills progeny homozygous for the opposing haplotype, favoring heterozygotes. Their antidotes, SGYN-1 and SIF-1, evolved from F-box proteins, although SIF-1 subsequently lost its F-box domain. We solved the crystal structure of the THOR-1-SIF-1 complex and used in vivo mutagenesis to validate the binding interface, supporting direct toxin neutralization independently of F-box-mediated degradation. A survey of 676 wild isolates revealed two contrasting evolutionary outcomes of antagonizing TAs: independently evolved loki-1/sgyn-1 and thor-1/sif-1 remain confined to alternative hyperdivergent haplotypes, whereas other homologous TAs can recombine to form composite haplotypes. Altogether, our findings establish competition among selfish elements as a distinct form of genetic conflict, and support models in which antagonistic TAs act as barriers that restrict gene flow between neighboring populations.
papers.translated_summary: 遗传冲突驱动演化创新，然而大多数研究都集中在自私元件与其宿主之间的军备竞赛上。第二层冲突——自私元件之间的竞争——在很大程度上仍未被探索。在此，我们揭示了热带秀丽隐杆线虫中两个拮抗性毒素-解毒剂元件（TAs）之间的这种冲突，即loki-1/sgyn-1与thor-1/sif-1。每种毒素LOKI-1或THOR-1都会选择性地杀死对相反单倍型纯合的后代，从而有利于杂合子。它们的解毒剂SGYN-1和SIF-1从F-box蛋白演化而来，尽管SIF-1随后失去了其F-box结构域。我们解析了THOR-1-SIF-1复合物的晶体结构，并通过体内诱变验证了结合界面，支持不依赖F-box介导降解的直接毒素中和作用。对676个野生分离株的调查揭示了拮抗性TAs的两种截然不同的演化结果：独立演化的loki-1/sgyn-1和thor-1/sif-1仍局限于替代性高度分化的单倍型，而其他同源TAs可以重组形成复合单倍型。总之，我们的发现确立了自私元件之间的竞争作为一种独特的遗传冲突形式，并支持了拮抗性TAs作为限制邻近种群之间基因流动的屏障的模型。

papers.title: A foldable respiratory siphon enables near-surface locomotion through asymmetric rowing in Helophilus larvae
papers.translated_title: 一种可折叠的呼吸虹吸管使Helophilus幼虫能够通过不对称划动实现近表面运动
papers.author: Matsunaga, T.
papers.summary: Specialized animal structures often perform multiple functions, yet how their structural adaptations support distinct behaviors remains poorly understood. Eristaline hoverfly larvae, commonly known as rat-tailed maggots, possess exceptionally elongated and extensible posterior respiratory siphons that allow them to breathe while submerged. Here, we investigated the structural basis of siphon extension and its potential locomotor function in Helophilus virgatus larvae. Fluorescence labeling showed that siphon elongation involves the unfolding of previously concealed structures, while phalloidin staining revealed an extensive array of transversely oriented muscle fibers within the siphon. Behavioral observations further revealed a previously undescribed mode of horizontal locomotion just beneath the air water interface, involving asymmetric rowing movements of the posterior siphon. Kinematic analyses showed that most forward body displacements occurred during the backward stroke, which was associated with increased siphon straightness, whereas the forward stroke produced little net forward displacement. These findings reveal structural features underlying siphon extensibility and demonstrate that a specialized respiratory organ also contributes to locomotion, highlighting the multifunctionality of specialized body structures in aquatic environments.
papers.translated_summary: 特化的动物结构常具有多种功能，然而其结构适应如何支持不同行为仍知之甚少。Eristaline食蚜蝇幼虫，俗称鼠尾蛆，具有异常延长且可伸展的后部呼吸虹吸管，使其能够在浸没状态下呼吸。本文研究了Helophilus virgatus幼虫虹吸管伸展的结构基础及其潜在的运动功能。荧光标记显示，虹吸管的伸长涉及先前隐藏结构的展开，而鬼笔环肽染色则揭示了虹吸管内广泛分布的横向肌纤维阵列。行为观察进一步揭示了一种此前未被描述的水气界面正下方水平运动模式，涉及后部虹吸管的不对称划桨运动。运动学分析表明，大多数身体向前位移发生在后划阶段，该阶段与虹吸管直线度增加相关，而前划阶段产生的净向前位移很小。这些发现揭示了虹吸管可伸展性的结构特征，并证明特化的呼吸器官也有助于运动，突显了水生环境中特化身体结构的多功能性。

papers.title: Curated neurodegeneration axis signals are sensitive to cell composition and analytic choices: an adversarial re-analysis of a transcriptomic scoring pipeline
papers.translated_title: 精选的神经退行性轴信号对细胞组成和分析选择敏感：对转录组评分流程的对抗性再分析
papers.author: Ghosh, N.
papers.summary: Background: Curated gene-set ("axis") scores are widely used to summarise disease biology in postmortem brain transcriptomes. In bulk tissue such scores can also change with cell-type composition, with broad transcriptome shifts in diseased tissue, or with analysis choices made after the results were seen. We tested these explanations on our own published pipeline, NeuroFate, whose preprint reported an Alzheimer's disease (AD) "neuronal vulnerability" axis and a Parkinson's disease (PD) "divergent" synuclein-mitochondrial axis. Results: A code audit found that the AD discovery axis averaged Sst, Pvalb and Lamp5 interneuron cell-type proportions together with its gene-expression features; that 90 endpoint x axis tests were run before the endpoints were locked; that axes were defined from the cohorts later cited as discovery evidence; and that the PD-divergent label came from an axis-specific rule defined after the result. Their contribution to the AD association could not be quantified because the donor-level data were not archived. In GSE7621 (16 PD, 9 controls) the synuclein-mitochondrial association reproduced (exact p = 0.0011) but depended on the scoring method (exact p from 0.001 to 0.057; with per-gene standardisation no axis reached Benjamini-Hochberg significance), lay at the 2.4th percentile of 10,000 expression-matched random probe sets (two-sided p = 0.06), and was attenuated by 76% (95% interval 26% to >100%) after adjustment for a dopaminergic-marker expression proxy (PD coefficient -1.13 to -0.27 SD). A small laser-captured cohort (GSE20141; 10 PD, 8 controls) was inconclusive: no axis reached p < 0.05, and the synuclein-mitochondrial effect had the same sign. In 1,000 simulated cohorts, a naive test called a purely composition-driven gene set significant in 82% of cohorts, whereas the proposed battery classified it as composition-independent in 5% while recovering a planted within-cell effect in 98% (moderate effect) and 50% (weak effect) of cohorts. Conclusions: The original axis associations do not establish composition-independent disease programs; their interpretation is sensitive to feature construction, scoring and adjustment for cell composition. Curated axis scores in bulk brain tissue should be reported with competitive null distributions, composition adjustment, exact small-sample inference, and endpoints and scoring fixed before analysis. We provide code for these checks.
papers.translated_summary: 背景： curated gene-set（“轴”）评分被广泛用于概括死后脑转录组中的疾病生物学特征。在 bulk 组织中，此类评分也可能随细胞类型组成、疾病组织中广泛的转录组变化，或结果出现后所做的分析选择而改变。我们在自己已发表的流程 NeuroFate 上检验了这些解释，该流程的预印本报告了一个阿尔茨海默病（AD）“神经元脆弱性”轴和一个帕金森病（PD）“分歧性”突触核蛋白-线粒体轴。结果： 代码审计发现，AD 发现轴将其基因表达特征与 Sst、Pvalb 和 Lamp5 中间神经元细胞类型比例一起平均；在终点锁定之前运行了 90 个终点×轴检验；轴是从后来被引用为发现证据的队列中定义的；PD-分歧标签来自结果之后定义的轴特异性规则。它们对 AD 关联的贡献无法量化，因为供体水平数据未归档。在 GSE7621（16 例 PD，9 例对照）中，突触核蛋白-线粒体关联得到重现（精确 p = 0.0011），但依赖于评分方法（精确 p 从 0.001 到 0.057；采用逐基因标准化后，没有任何轴达到 Benjamini-Hochberg 显著性），位于 10,000 个表达匹配随机探针集的第 2.4 百分位（双侧 p = 0.06），并且在调整多巴胺能标志物表达代理后衰减 76%（95% 区间 26% 至 >100%）（PD 系数 -1.13 至 -0.27 SD）。一个小型激光捕获队列（GSE20141；10 例 PD，8 例对照）结果不确定：没有轴达到 p < 0.05，且突触核蛋白-线粒体效应具有相同符号。在 1,000 个模拟队列中，朴素检验在 82% 的队列中将纯组成驱动的基因集称为显著，而所提出的检验组在 5% 中将其分类为组成独立，同时在 98%（中等效应）和 50%（弱效应）的队列中恢复了植入的细胞内效应。结论： 原始轴关联不能确立组成独立的疾病程序；其解释对特征构建、评分和细胞组成调整敏感。bulk 脑组织中的 curated 轴评分应报告竞争性零分布、组成调整、精确小样本推断，并在分析前固定终点和评分。我们提供了这些检查的代码。

papers.title: Building computational benchmarks: an Omnibenchmark reimplementation of a single-cell preprocessing pipeline evaluation
papers.translated_title: 构建计算基准：单细胞预处理流程评估的Omnibenchmark重实现
papers.author: Choudhury, A.
papers.summary: Background: In the past few years, we have seen a veritable surge in single-cell (e.g., RNA-sequencing) techniques and datasets, enabling increasingly detailed characterization of cellular heterogeneity across tissues and conditions. This surge in single-cell techniques has been complemented by a large number of analysis frameworks and pipelines, and a large parameter space and researcher degrees of freedom to use them. Many neutral benchmarks have been presented for various computational tasks, but most make design decisions that render them incompatible with each other, e.g., through the use of different datasets, metrics, or parameter sets. Results: We showcase Omnibenchmark, a recently developed framework to build reproducible, extensible, and standardized method comparisons for an arms-length benchmark that evaluates five single-cell RNA sequencing pipelines, spanning filtering, normalization, dimensionality reduction, and clustering, on three datasets. The framework facilitates the broad investigation of pipelines used in single-cell data analysis while highlighting how the process of building benchmarks can be streamlined and unified. This standardization enables benchmarks to be extended in several directions, including broader parameter sweeps, comparisons across software versions and architectures, isolation of pipeline steps, and integration of additional pipelines, datasets, and metrics. As an example, our harmonization of pipelines highlighted that tools implement the (clustering) resolution parameter differently. Conclusions: Omnibenchmark provides a reproducible, extensible, and standardized approach for benchmarking. By unifying the process of benchmark construction, it can facilitate more consistent method comparisons and provides a foundation for broader, more flexible, and more sustainable benchmarking efforts.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：过去几年中，单细胞（例如RNA测序）技术和数据集出现了名副其实的激增，使得跨组织和条件下的细胞异质性表征日益精细。单细胞技术的激增伴随着大量分析框架和流程，以及使用它们的大量参数空间和研究者自由度。许多中性基准已被提出用于各种计算任务，但大多数在设计决策上彼此不兼容，例如通过使用不同的数据集、指标或参数集。结果：我们展示了Omnibenchmark，这是一个最近开发的框架，用于构建可重复、可扩展和标准化的方法比较，作为一个独立基准，在三个数据集上评估五个单细胞RNA测序流程，涵盖过滤、归一化、降维和聚类。该框架促进了对单细胞数据分析中所用流程的广泛研究，同时突出了如何简化和统一基准构建过程。这种标准化使基准能够在多个方向上扩展，包括更广泛的参数扫描、跨软件版本和架构的比较、流程步骤的隔离，以及额外流程、数据集和指标的整合。作为一个例子，我们对流程的协调突出表明，工具对（聚类）分辨率参数的实现方式不同。结论：Omnibenchmark提供了一种可重复、可扩展和标准化的基准测试方法。通过统一基准构建过程，它可以促进更一致的方法比较，并为更广泛、更灵活和更可持续的基准测试工作提供基础。

papers.title: The insect brain is specified by a conserved transcriptional program distinct from the segmental CNS
papers.translated_title: 昆虫大脑由一种与分节中枢神经系统不同的保守转录程序所指定
papers.author: Cabanas, N.
papers.summary: The brain is the central processing center that integrates information to guide animal behavior, while the posterior CNS performs less central functions. To what degree this functional distinction is reflected in divergence of the genetic regulation remains unexplored, as well as the hypothesis of a distinct evolutionary origin of brain and trunk CNS. In insects, neuroblast biology is similar across the CNS, but the presence of brain-specific neuroblast types and differences in the gene sets involved in their spatial and temporal specification indicate divergence. However, a comprehensive and unbiased comparison of the regulatory code of brain versus trunk neuroblasts has been lacking. Here, we reveal the transcription factors expressed in insect embryonic neuroblasts by a combined single-cell analysis from the fly Drosophila melanogaster and the beetle Tribolium castaneum, for which we established a Gal4 enhancer trap system to generate a line marking NBs with tGFP. From the combined dataset of nearly 70,000 neuroblasts, we identified around 23,000 brain neuroblasts, from which we identified cell populations and their transcriptional signatures. We found 188 brain-specific TFs, including seven spatially restricted transcription factors not previously associated with neuroblasts (Hmx, CG15696, CG32532, dmrt99B, fD59A, TfAP-2, and Fer1). In addition to the expected canonical Type II NBs, we found two related clusters with intriguing transcriptional divergence. The large number of brain-specific TFs supports a profound divergence between the insect brain and posterior CNS. Together with recent work in vertebrates, our data confirm an ancient divergence of the brain from the trunk.
papers.translated_summary: 大脑是整合信息以指导动物行为的中央处理中心，而后部中枢神经系统则执行较少中枢性的功能。这种功能区分在基因调控分化中的反映程度尚未被探索，关于大脑与躯干中枢神经系统具有不同进化起源的假说也尚未被研究。在昆虫中，神经母细胞生物学在整个中枢神经系统中是相似的，但脑特异性神经母细胞类型的存在及其空间和时间特化所涉及基因集的差异表明存在分化。然而，一直缺乏对脑与躯干神经母细胞调控密码的全面且无偏见的比较。在此，我们通过结合果蝇Drosophila melanogaster和甲虫Tribolium castaneum的单细胞分析，揭示了昆虫胚胎神经母细胞中表达的转录因子，其中我们建立了一个Gal4增强子陷阱系统来生成标记tGFP神经母细胞的品系。从近70，000个神经母细胞的合并数据集中，我们鉴定出约23，000个脑神经母细胞，从中我们识别了细胞群体及其转录特征。我们发现了188个脑特异性转录因子，包括七个先前未与神经母细胞关联的空间限制性转录因子（Hmx、CG15696、CG32532、dmrt99B、fD59A、TfAP-2和Fer1）。除了预期的经典II型神经母细胞外，我们还发现了两个具有有趣转录分化的相关簇。大量脑特异性转录因子支持昆虫大脑与后部中枢神经系统之间的深刻分化。结合最近在脊椎动物中的工作，我们的数据证实了大脑与躯干之间的古老分化。

papers.title: A bistable type III secretion system is primed and loaded in Pseudomonas aeruginosa hypervirulent isolates with positively selected codon changes in exsA or exsD
papers.translated_title: III型分泌系统呈双稳态，在铜绿假单胞菌高毒力分离株中被启动并装载，这些分离株在exsA或exsD中具有正选择密码子改变
papers.author: Reuven, A.
papers.summary: Pseudomonas aeruginosa has multiple virulence factors that promote airway infections in people with immune deficiencies. Most clinical isolates from human infections have functional type III secretion systems (T3SSs) that are subject to bistable regulation and secrete the cytotoxic effector ExoS into neutrophils. During airway infection in people with cystic fibrosis (CF), P. aeruginosa maintains bistable regulation or genetically adapts by inactivating or hyperactivating T3SS expression. CF clinical isolates with hyperactive T3SSs have codon changes in the transcriptional regulators, exsA or exsD. It is not known how these mutations: 1) arise, 2) promote hypervirulence, or 3) impact bistable T3SS regulation. To understand how these mutants arise, ~24,000 genomes in the NCBI Pathogens database were searched for positively selected mutations in exs genes based on nonsynonomous to synonymous codon change ratios. Missense and nonsense mutations were detected in exsA (47) or exsD (45) the majority of which are predicted to be positively selected. To determine how one of these codon changes promotes hypervirulence, an exsAT48I isolate was used to establish lung infections in mice engineered with a CF genotype. The exsAT48I mutant and an exsA+ control had similar lung burdens, but the former caused exacerbated weight loss and lung inflammation, suggesting immunopathology from phagocyte death as the cause of hypervirulence. Two additional hyperactive mutants were identified by screening a small collection of isolates from children with CF. Immunoblotting and fluorescence microscopy showed that hyperactive exsA or exsD mutants increased production of T3SS injectisomes and effectors, indicating they have locked on (primed and loaded) phenotypes. ExsA dimer modeling revealed that codon changes like T48I in the {beta}-barrel domain cause a conformational change that hyperactivates the transcription factor. These results define that hyperactive mutants are positively selected, hypervirulent due to lung inflammation, and have primed and loaded T3SSs.
papers.translated_summary: 铜绿假单胞菌具有多种毒力因子，可促进免疫缺陷人群的气道感染。来自人类感染的大多数临床分离株具有功能性III型分泌系统（T3SS），该系统受双稳态调控，并将细胞毒性效应蛋白ExoS分泌至中性粒细胞中。在囊性纤维化（CF）患者的气道感染过程中，铜绿假单胞菌维持双稳态调控，或通过失活或过度激活T3SS表达进行遗传适应。具有过度活跃T3SS的CF临床分离株在转录调控因子exsA或exsD中存在密码子改变。目前尚不清楚这些突变如何：1）产生，2）促进高毒力，或3）影响双稳态T3SS调控。为了解这些突变体如何产生，基于非同义与同义密码子改变比值，在NCBI病原体数据库中约24,000个基因组中搜索了exs基因中受正选择的突变。在exsA（47个）或exsD（45个）中检测到错义和无义突变，其中大多数预测受正选择。为确定其中一个密码子改变如何促进高毒力，使用一株exsAT48I分离株在具有CF基因型的小鼠中建立肺部感染。exsAT48I突变体与exsA+对照具有相似的肺部载量，但前者引起加重的体重减轻和肺部炎症，提示吞噬细胞死亡导致的免疫病理是高毒力的原因。通过对来自CF患儿的一小批分离株进行筛选，鉴定出另外两个过度活跃突变体。免疫印迹和荧光显微镜显示，过度活跃的exsA或exsD突变体增加了T3SS注射体（injectisome）和效应蛋白的产生，表明它们具有锁定开启（预启和装载）的表型。ExsA二聚体建模揭示，{beta}-桶状结构域中如T48I的密码子改变引起构象变化，从而过度激活该转录因子。这些结果明确了过度活跃突变体受正选择、因肺部炎症而具有高毒力，并具有预启和装载的T3SS。

papers.title: Ocean depth modifies host-microbiome ecology and evolution
papers.translated_title: 海洋深度改变宿主-微生物组生态与演化
papers.author: Diez-Vives, C.
papers.summary: A major unsolved question in ecology and evolution is how similar free-living and symbiotic microbial communities are. In marine systems, depth homogenises free-living communities due to stronger dispersal and weaker environmental filtering compared to surface waters. We show that symbiotic communities of marine sponges follow a different pattern, with a subset of sponge species mirroring the increased similarity with depth seen in their free-living counterparts, while others remain highly host-specific both in shallow and deep waters. Moreover, in deep waters, more phylogenetically similar hosts harbor more similar microbiomes, yet host-symbiont cophylogeny nearly vanishes. This reveals two contrasting eco-evolutionary assembly rules: in more constant environments like the deep sea, community assembly is driven by host and environmental filtering with minimal signature of coevolution, whereas in variable environments, like shallow waters, host-symbiont coevolution is strong and key to maintain host-specific microbiomes.
papers.translated_summary: 生态学和进化生物学中一个尚未解决的重大问题是，自由生活与共生微生物群落的相似程度如何。在海洋系统中，与表层水体相比，由于更强的扩散作用和更弱的环境过滤，深度使自由生活群落趋于均质化。我们发现，海洋海绵的共生群落遵循一种不同的模式：一部分海绵物种与其自由生活对应物一样，表现出随深度增加相似性升高的趋势，而另一些物种无论在浅水还是深水都保持高度的宿主特异性。此外，在深水中，系统发育上更相似的宿主拥有更相似的微生物组，然而宿主-共生体共系统发育关系几乎消失。这揭示了两种截然不同的生态-进化组装规则：在像深海这样更为恒定的环境中，群落组装由宿主过滤和环境过滤驱动，共进化的印记极小；而在像浅水这样多变的环境中，宿主-共生体共进化作用强烈，是维持宿主特异性微生物组的关键。

papers.title: Optimisation of single-nuclei isolation and RNA sequencing of parasitic nematodes
papers.translated_title: 寄生线虫单核分离及RNA测序的优化
papers.author: Buddenborg, S. K.
papers.summary: Single-cell/nuclei transcriptomics has revolutionised our understanding of cell, tissue, and organismal biology in humans and model organisms across health and disease. However, for non-model species, reassessment and refinement of conventional methods is needed to address novel technical and biological challenges. Here, we evaluate three established nuclei isolation protocols and, building on these experiences, develop an optimised protocol for single-nuclei isolation of parasitic nematodes (SNIP). SNIP recovered 1.7- to 4.1-fold more nuclei than the three established protocols, and 3.2-fold more RNA per nucleus than the best-performing of these. We validated SNIP across macroscopic and microscopic life stages and both sexes of two phylogenetically distinct gastrointestinal nematodes, Haemonchus contortus and Trichuris muris, and used it to generate single-nuclei RNA-seq data revealing sex- and stage-specific gene expression and putative tissue-specific expression in both species. By enabling flexibility with frozen samples and consistent recovery across diverse parasitic nematode life stages, SNIP provides a practical foundation for building cell and nuclei atlases in other non-model species, toward advancing understanding from fundamental biology to infection and disease.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞/细胞核转录组学已经彻底改变了我们对人类和模式生物在健康与疾病状态下细胞、组织和整体生物学的理解。然而，对于非模式物种，需要重新评估和优化传统方法，以应对新的技术和生物学挑战。在此，我们评估了三种已有的细胞核分离方案，并在此基础上开发了一种针对寄生线虫单细胞核分离的优化方案（SNIP）。SNIP 回收的细胞核数量比三种已有方案多 1.7 至 4.1 倍，每个细胞核的 RNA 回收量比其中表现最佳的方案多 3.2 倍。我们在两种系统发育上不同的胃肠道线虫——捻转血矛线虫（Haemonchus contortus）和鼠鞭虫（Trichuris muris）——的宏观和微观生活史阶段及两种性别中验证了 SNIP，并利用它生成了单细胞核 RNA 测序数据，揭示了两个物种中性别和生活史阶段特异性的基因表达以及推测的组织特异性表达。SNIP 能够灵活处理冷冻样本，并在多种寄生线虫生活史阶段中实现一致的回收效果，为在其他非模式物种中构建细胞和细胞核图谱提供了实用基础，有助于推动从基础生物学到感染与疾病的理解。

papers.title: Horizontal transfer of an antimicrobial peptide across insects
papers.translated_title: 抗菌肽在昆虫间的水平转移
papers.author: Aumont, C.
papers.summary: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are key defence molecules of the innate immune system. Understanding the origins of AMPs can help to explain how immune systems acquire novelty and vary in their defence capacities. However, AMPs evolve rapidly, and so the origins of similar AMPs across organisms is often unclear. Furthermore, false negatives due to low search sensitivity are common and can hinder confident annotations about true absences. As a result, understanding whether similar AMP genes found in diverse organisms represent ancestral molecules or evolutionary novelties has been challenging. Here, we present evidence of horizontal gene transfer (HGT) of the antifungal peptide gene Drosomycin across insects. We show that in Diptera, the presence of Drosomycin is restricted to the Drosophila Melanogaster species group and additionally the distant relative Drosophila busckii. We go on to recover Drosomycin genes in cockroaches (Blattodea), mantises (Mantodea), katydids (Orthoptera), beetles (Coleoptera), parasitic wasps (Hymenoptera), and a recently acquired and pseudogenized Drosomycin locus in Liposcelis booklice (Psocodea), but not other insects. Explaining this diversity through shared ancestry requires at least 60 independent loss events, or just nine HGT events. Previous studies have suggested that similar AMPs found across divergent species reflect conservation from a common ancestor, or due to their small size, that they arose via convergent evolution. Our findings suggest horizontal gene transfer can be responsible for the presence of some AMP genes scattered across the tree of life. By presenting a mechanism through which immune systems can acquire novelty, our study also suggests a possible explanation for certain lineage-specific defence competencies against infectious disease. While loss of AMP genes is well-documented, here we suggest gain of AMPs can occur just as suddenly.
papers.translated_summary: 抗菌肽（AMPs）是先天免疫系统的关键防御分子。理解抗菌肽的起源有助于解释免疫系统如何获得新特性以及其防御能力为何存在差异。然而，抗菌肽进化迅速，因此不同生物中相似抗菌肽的起源往往不明确。此外，由于搜索灵敏度低而导致的假阴性很常见，这可能妨碍对真正缺失的可靠注释。因此，理解不同生物中发现的相似抗菌肽基因究竟代表祖先分子还是进化新特性一直具有挑战性。在此，我们提供了抗真菌肽基因Drosomycin在昆虫间发生水平基因转移（HGT）的证据。我们表明，在双翅目中，Drosomycin的存在仅限于黑腹果蝇种组以及另外的近缘种Drosophila busckii。我们进一步在蟑螂（蜚蠊目）、螳螂（螳螂目）、螽斯（直翅目）、甲虫（鞘翅目）、寄生蜂（膜翅目）中发现了Drosomycin基因，并在Liposcelis书虱（啮虫目）中发现了一个近期获得且已假基因化的Drosomycin位点，但在其他昆虫中未发现。通过共同祖先来解释这种多样性至少需要60次独立丢失事件，或者仅需九次水平基因转移事件。此前的研究曾提出，在不同物种中发现的相似抗菌肽反映了来自共同祖先的保守性，或者由于其体积小，是通过趋同进化产生的。我们的发现表明，水平基因转移可能是某些抗菌肽基因散布于生命树中的原因。通过提出一种免疫系统可以获得新特性的机制，我们的研究还为某些谱系对传染病的特异性防御能力提供了一种可能的解释。虽然抗菌肽基因的丢失已有充分文献记载，但我们在此提出抗菌肽的获得同样可以突然发生。

papers.title: Genetic control and tissue specificity of transcriptomic rhythmicity
papers.translated_title: 转录组节律性的遗传控制与组织特异性
papers.author: Chauquet, S.
papers.summary: Circadian rhythms influence molecular traits in most tissues, yet genetic studies mostly treat molecular measurements as static. In particular, genetic effects on gene expression are typically investigated through expression quantitative trait locus (eQTL) studies, which ignore sampling time and therefore miss genetic effects on rhythm parameters such as amplitude and acrophase. In this study, we used a cosinor-based joint genotype-by-rhythm interaction framework applied to GTEx version 10 gene expression data, with donor inferred phase as a proxy for circadian time. We first identified rhythmically expressed genes in 49 of the 50 tissues profiled in GTEx. We then tested common variants within 50 kb of each rhythmic gene's transcription start site for genetic regulation of transcriptomic rhythmicity. We identified 167 circadian expression QTLs (cd-eQTLs), comprising 54 lead signals for 51 genes across 28 tissues. Most cd-eQTLs altered oscillation amplitude, while others affected acrophase or both. We then investigated the tissue specificity of cd-eQTLs and found that those acting on core circadian genes had consistent effects across tissues, whereas those acting on clock-regulated genes were largely tissue-specific. A phenome-wide association study in the Pan-UK Biobank linked 34 cd-eQTLs to 100 phenotypes, including self-reported chronotype, adiposity, blood cell counts and blood biochemistry. These results show that genetic variation shapes circadian gene expression in a tissue-dependent manner, and that accounting for time of day reveals regulatory effects that static eQTL analyses cannot detect.
papers.translated_summary: 昼夜节律影响大多数组织中的分子特征，然而遗传学研究大多将分子测量视为静态。特别是，基因表达的遗传效应通常通过表达数量性状位点（eQTL）研究来探究，这些研究忽略了采样时间，因而错过了对振幅和峰值相位等节律参数的遗传效应。在本研究中，我们采用基于余弦分析的基因型-节律交互联合框架，应用于GTEx第10版基因表达数据，以推断的供体相位作为昼夜节律时间的代理。我们首先在GTEx所分析的50个组织中的49个中鉴定了节律性表达基因。随后，我们在每个节律性基因转录起始位点50 kb范围内的常见变异中检测了转录组节律性的遗传调控。我们鉴定了167个昼夜节律表达QTL（cd-eQTL），包括28个组织中51个基因的54个先导信号。大多数cd-eQTL改变了振荡振幅，而其他则影响峰值相位或两者兼有。接着我们研究了cd-eQTL的组织特异性，发现作用于核心昼夜节律基因的cd-eQTL在各组织中具有一致效应，而作用于时钟调控基因的cd-eQTL则大多具有组织特异性。在Pan-UK Biobank中进行的全表型组关联研究将34个cd-eQTL与100个表型相关联，包括自我报告的时型、肥胖度、血细胞计数和血液生化指标。这些结果表明，遗传变异以组织依赖的方式塑造昼夜节律基因表达，且考虑一天中的时间可揭示静态eQTL分析无法检测到的调控效应。

papers.title: Electronic Health Record Evaluation of the Preconception Medical Assessment for Maternal Morbidity
papers.translated_title: 孕前医学评估对孕产妇发病率影响的电子健康记录评价
papers.author: Khan, U.
papers.summary: Importance: Severe maternal morbidity is increasingly driven by chronic conditions present before pregnancy, but existing obstetric comorbidity indices rely on clinician documentation and are not designed for preconception use. Objective: To determine whether conditions represented in a patient-facing preconception assessment are associated with severe maternal morbidity comparably with clinician-derived indices. Design: Retrospective cohort study of deliveries from 1992 to 2025; scores were derived from diagnoses recorded at least 280 days before delivery. Setting: Two deidentified electronic health record databases covering an academic and public health system in San Francisco and 5 other University of California medical centers. Participants: Birthing individuals aged 12 to 55 years at delivery with at least 10 clinical events recorded before conception. Exposures: Preconception Medical Assessment (PreMA) score (range, 0-8) and the Bateman (range, 0-51) and Leonard (range, 0-281) obstetric comorbidity indices, modeled per 1-SD increase. Main Outcomes and Measures: Severe maternal morbidity and nontransfusion severe maternal morbidity within 7 days of delivery, defined by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention indicators. Results: Among 58,549 deliveries (21,427 in the San Francisco cohort [mean (SD) maternal age, 33.4 (5.7) years]; 37,122 in the statewide cohort [33.1 (5.4) years]), each 1-SD increase in PreMA score was associated with severe maternal morbidity in the San Francisco cohort (relative risk [RR], 1.23; 95% CI, 1.19-1.28), similar to the Bateman (RR, 1.26; 95% CI, 1.22-1.29) and Leonard (RR, 1.26; 95% CI, 1.23-1.30) indices; statewide findings were consistent. Severe maternal morbidity rose from 6.6% at a score of 0 to 9.0% at 1 to 3 and 17.8% at 4 or greater (statewide, 3.8%, 5.3%, and 14.5%). Associations persisted across racial, ethnic, and neighborhood deprivation subgroups. Cardiovascular conditions (RR, 3.08; 95% CI, 2.50-3.80) and diabetes (RR, 1.83; 95% CI, 1.34-2.48) were most strongly associated with nontransfusion severe maternal morbidity. Conclusions and Relevance: In this cohort study, higher scores on a patient-facing preconception assessment were associated with severe maternal morbidity, comparably with clinician-derived indices. Prospective studies are needed before scores are used clinically.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：严重孕产妇发病率日益受到妊娠前已存在的慢性疾病驱动，但现有的产科合并症指数依赖临床医生的记录，并非为孕前使用而设计。目的：确定患者自评的孕前评估中所包含的疾病是否与严重孕产妇发病率相关，且相关性可与临床医生衍生的指数相媲美。设计：对1992年至2025年的分娩进行回顾性队列研究；评分源自分娩前至少280天记录的诊断。环境：两个去标识化的电子健康记录数据库，涵盖旧金山的一个学术和公共卫生系统以及另外5个加州大学医学中心。参与者：分娩时年龄12至55岁、且在受孕前记录有至少10次临床事件的分娩个体。暴露：孕前医学评估（PreMA）评分（范围0-8）以及Bateman（范围0-51）和Leonard（范围0-281）产科合并症指数，按每增加1个标准差建模。主要结局和指标：分娩后7天内的严重孕产妇发病率和非输血严重孕产妇发病率，由美国疾病控制与预防中心指标定义。结果：在58,549例分娩中（旧金山队列21,427例[母亲年龄均值（标准差）33.4（5.7）岁]；全州队列37,122例[33.1（5.4）岁]），PreMA评分每增加1个标准差与旧金山队列中的严重孕产妇发病率相关（相对危险度[RR]，1.23；95% CI，1.19-1.28），与Bateman（RR，1.26；95% CI，1.22-1.29）和Leonard（RR，1.26；95% CI，1.23-1.30）指数相似；全州范围内的结果一致。严重孕产妇发病率从评分为0时的6.6%上升至1至3分时的9.0%以及4分或以上时的17.8%（全州范围内分别为3.8%、5.3%和14.5%）。这些关联在种族、族裔和社区贫困亚组中持续存在。心血管疾病（RR，3.08；95% CI，2.50-3.80）和糖尿病（RR，1.83；95% CI，1.34-2.48）与非输血严重孕产妇发病率的关联最强。结论与意义：在这项队列研究中，患者自评孕前评估的较高评分与严重孕产妇发病率相关，且与临床医生衍生的指数相当。在评分用于临床之前，需要进行前瞻性研究。

papers.title: Spinal Manipulation and Other Conservative Treatments for Acute and Chronic Low Back Pain Compared With Natural History and Sham: A Bayesian Network Meta-Analysis
papers.translated_title: 脊柱手法及其他保守治疗与自然病程和假治疗对急性和慢性下腰痛的比较：一项贝叶斯网络荟萃分析
papers.author: Menke, J. M.
papers.summary: BackgroundImprovement observed during treatment for low back pain (LBP) may reflect natural recovery, contextual response, and treatment-specific effects. We evaluated spinal manipulative therapy (SMT) and common treatment alternatives within the treatment network and against independently estimated natural history. MethodsWe conducted a Bayesian hierarchical evidence synthesis of 133 retained analytic units, analyzing acute and chronic LBP separately. Natural history was estimated from independent external natural-course/prognosis evidence, with posterior uncertainty propagated into the treatment analysis. The network meta-analysis (NMA) compared all treatment categories within each phase; independently estimated natural history provided an external reference for improvement beyond the expected clinical course. The sham category comprised placebo comparators and interventions known to be therapeutically ineffective. Recovery was defined primarily as pain [≤]2/10, with alternative definitions examined in sensitivity analyses. ResultsIn acute LBP, expected natural recovery was substantial. At 26 weeks, natural-history recovery was 77.3%, compared with 71.1% for SMT. SMT therefore produced -6.2 recoveries per 100 relative to natural history (95% interval -18.6 to +2.6) and +2.7 per 100 relative to sham (-5.7 to +12.5). In chronic LBP, natural-history recovery was 24.1% at 54 weeks. SMT and exercise exceeded natural history by +14.2 (+3.1 to +24.0) and +12.9 (+4.3 to +21.8) recoveries per 100, respectively, and exceeded sham by +12.9 (+2.4 to +22.5) and +11.6 (+3.4 to +20.7) per 100. ConclusionsThe apparent effectiveness of LBP treatment depends strongly on the natural course against which treatment-associated improvement is evaluated. In acute LBP, much of the observed improvement was compatible with expected natural recovery, with little evidence of additional benefit from SMT. In chronic LBP, where expected natural recovery was substantially less favorable, SMT and exercise showed evidence of benefit beyond both natural history and sham.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：腰痛（LBP）治疗过程中观察到的改善可能反映自然恢复、情境性反应以及治疗特异性效应。我们在治疗网络内评估了脊柱手法治疗（SMT）及常见替代治疗，并与独立估计的自然病史进行了比较。方法：我们对133个保留的分析单元进行了贝叶斯分层证据合成，分别分析急性腰痛和慢性腰痛。自然病史从独立的外部自然病程/预后证据中估计，并将后验不确定性传播至治疗分析中。网络荟萃分析（NMA）比较了每个阶段内的所有治疗类别；独立估计的自然病史为超出预期临床病程的改善提供了外部参照。假治疗类别包括安慰剂对照和已知治疗无效的干预措施。恢复主要定义为疼痛[≤]2/10，并在敏感性分析中检验了替代定义。结果：在急性腰痛中，预期自然恢复幅度较大。在第26周，自然病史恢复率为77.3%，而SMT为71.1%。因此，相对于自然病史，SMT每100人产生-6.2例恢复（95%区间-18.6至+2.6），相对于假治疗为+2.7例/100（-5.7至+12.5）。在慢性腰痛中，第54周自然病史恢复率为24.1%。SMT和运动疗法分别超出自然病史+14.2（+3.1至+24.0）和+12.9（+4.3至+21.8）例恢复/100，并分别超出假治疗+12.9（+2.4至+22.5）和+11.6（+3.4至+20.7）例/100。结论：腰痛治疗的表观有效性在很大程度上取决于用于评估治疗相关改善的自然病程参照。在急性腰痛中，大部分观察到的改善与预期自然恢复相符，几乎没有证据表明SMT具有额外获益。在慢性腰痛中，预期自然恢复明显较差，SMT和运动疗法显示出超越自然病史和假治疗的获益证据。

papers.title: Mass Spectrometry-Based Amyloid Typing in FFPE Biopsies: A Five-Year Prospective Experience from a Tertiary Academic Center in Spain
papers.translated_title: 基于质谱的FFPE活检淀粉样蛋白分型：来自西班牙一家三级学术中心的五年前瞻性经验
papers.author: Calamia, V.
papers.summary: Background: Accurate amyloid subtyping is essential for patient management but remains challenging with antibody-based methods. We prospectively evaluated a standardized LC-MS/MS workflow for routine amyloid typing, focusing on diagnostic yield, operational performance, and added value in cases not fully resolved by conventional methods. Methods: From 2020 to 2025, 115 FFPE biopsies from patients with suspected amyloidosis were analyzed at Hospital Universitario A Coruna, Spain, without laser microdissection. Proteins were identified and quantified using PEAKS, with a peak-area cutoff [≥]10 for candidate fibril proteins. Results: Seventy-nine cases (69%) were amyloid-positive, 22 (19%) negative and 14 (12%) indeterminate. AL (51%), ATTR (32%) and AA (10%) predominated, with additional AH (5%), mixed ATTR+AL, hereditary ATTRv and AIns amyloidoses. Binary concordance with conventional techniques ranged from 85.7% to 91.5%. LC-MS/MS provided additional diagnostic information in 64/110 evaluable cases (58.2%), including additional subtyping information in 53/110 (48.2%). The workflow also enabled relative quantification of variant versus wild-type TTR peptides and characterization of SAA post-translational modifications. Mean turnaround time was approximately two weeks and MS findings informed clinical management. Conclusions: LC-MS/MS amyloid typing was clinically feasible in routine FFPE biopsies without laser microdissection and supported identification of common, rare and mixed amyloid types.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：准确的淀粉样蛋白分型对患者管理至关重要，但基于抗体的方法仍具有挑战性。我们前瞻性评估了一套标准化的LC-MS/MS工作流程用于常规淀粉样蛋白分型，重点关注诊断率、运行性能以及在常规方法未能完全解决的病例中的附加价值。方法：2020年至2025年，在西班牙拉科鲁尼亚大学医院对115例疑似淀粉样变性患者的FFPE活检进行了分析，未采用激光显微切割。使用PEAKS对蛋白质进行鉴定和定量，候选纤维蛋白的峰面积截断值为[≥]10。结果：79例（69%）为淀粉样蛋白阳性，22例（19%）为阴性，14例（12%）为不确定。以AL（51%）、ATTR（32%）和AA（10%）为主，另有AH（5%）、混合型ATTR+AL、遗传性ATTRv和AIns淀粉样变性。与常规技术的二元一致性范围为85.7%至91.5%。LC-MS/MS在64/110例可评估病例（58.2%）中提供了额外的诊断信息，包括在53/110例（48.2%）中提供额外的分型信息。该工作流程还实现了变异型与野生型TTR肽段的相对定量以及SAA翻译后修饰的表征。平均周转时间约为两周，MS结果影响了临床管理。结论：LC-MS/MS淀粉样蛋白分型在未采用激光显微切割的常规FFPE活检中具有临床可行性，并支持常见、罕见和混合型淀粉样蛋白类型的鉴定。

papers.title: Additional therapies after minimally invasive treatments in women with OAB
papers.translated_title: 女性OAB微创治疗后的附加疗法
papers.author: Zheng, Y.
papers.summary: ObjectiveTo evaluate the rate, timing, and predictors of additional therapy among women with idiopathic overactive bladder (OAB) following initial minimally invasive treatments (MIT). Study DesignRetrospective single center cohort study of women with idiopathic OAB treated between 2012 and 2021. Using ICD and procedural codes, we identified women who underwent posterior tibial nerve stimulation (PTNS), sacral neuromodulation (SNM), or intradetrusor onabotulinumtoxinA (BTX). The primary outcome was receipt of additional OAB treatments,OAB medication initiation or a different MIT. Kaplan-Meier analysis estimated time to additional therapies; Cox proportional hazards and random survival forest models identified predictors. Results1,007 women were included (PTNS: 459; SNM: 192; BTX: 356). At three years, 75% of PTNS patients, 58% of BTX patients, and 40% of SNM women required additional therapies with most patients choosing additional pharmacotherapy rather than crossover to a different MIT. Median time to additional treatments was 10 months (PTNS), 19 months (BTX), and 53 months (SNM). Higher BMI was associated with increased risk of further treatment after SNM (HR 2.1, 95% CI: 1.1-4.2), while recurrent urinary tract infections were associated with needing additional therapies in the BTX cohort (HR 1.8, 95% CI: 1.1-3.2). Random survival forest models resulted in poor model performance. ConclusionsFollowing initial MIT for idiopathic OAB, many women required additional treatment within three years, many choosing pharmacotherapy rather than transition to another MIT. Why This MattersOveractive bladder (OAB) affects over 20% of women in the United States, and current AUA/SUFU guidelines have shifted from traditional stepwise therapy toward shared decision-making and multimodal treatment. While minimally invasive therapies (MIT) are effective options for OAB, real-world data on patient trajectories after MIT initiation, including rates of treatment augmentation, crossover, or return to pharmacotherapy, remain limited. This retrospective cohort of 1,007 women with idiopathic OAB provides novel data on post-MIT care-seeking, with 40-75% of patients requiring additional therapy within three years. SNM demonstrated the longest interval before additional therapy and the lowest rate of subsequent care-seeking. Notably, most women who required additional treatment chose pharmacotherapy rather than crossing over to a different MIT. Modifiable risk factors associated with additional care-seeking included higher BMI after SNM and recurrent urinary tract infections after BTX, though whether addressing these factors would reduce the need for additional therapy remains unclear. These findings reinforce that OAB management is a dynamic, ongoing process rather than a one-time intervention, and that multimodal therapy is often necessary for optimal improvement. Clinicians can use these data to set realistic expectations during counseling, framing additional therapy as a common and anticipated part of the treatment trajectory rather than a treatment failure.

papers.title: Pallidal Local Field Potentials markers of dystonia aetiology and severity in children
papers.translated_title: 儿童肌张力障碍病因和严重程度的苍白球局部场电位标志物
papers.author: Faiman, I.
papers.summary: Background: Aberrant basal ganglia activity is a key feature of the pathophysiology of dystonia, but evidence is predominantly based on adult cohorts. Neurophysiological signatures during development remain poorly characterised. Local field potentials (LFPs) recorded by bidirectional neurostimulators provide a direct measure of globus pallidus internus (GPi) activity. In a cross-sectional paediatric cohort, we investigated whether pallidal oscillatory, aperiodic and connectivity characteristics are associated with dystonia severity and whether these differ between genetic and acquired dystonias. Methods: We recruited 30 children and young adults (5-20 years) with medically refractory dystonia (genetic n = 10; acquired n = 20) who underwent bilateral GPi Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) implantation. Ten minutes of pallidal LFPs were recorded using Medtronic Percept RC neurostimulators with stimulation off, before DBS activation and, where available, at 12 months. Spectral power, aperiodic exponent and interhemispheric pallidopallidal coherence were quantified across delta (1-4 Hz), theta (4-8 Hz), alpha (8-13 Hz), beta (13-30 Hz), and low-gamma (30-45 Hz) frequency bands. Linear mixed-effects models were implemented to establish whether LFP markers were predictive of dystonia severity, as measured by the Burke-Fahn-Marsden Dystonia Rating Scale (BFMDRS-Movement). Firths Bias-Reduced Logistic Regression assessed whether LFP markers were predictive of dystonia aetiology. Results: Spectral peaks were most consistently detected in the delta, beta, and low-gamma bands. Delta and low-gamma peak power significantly predicted dystonia severity. This association was independent of medication burden, structural GPi involvement, and dystonia aetiology. Theta and alpha peaks were detected less consistently, and their power was not associated with dystonia severity. Pallidopallidal coherence significantly predicted dystonia severity in interaction with medication load in all frequency bands. Low-gamma peak power was significantly lower in acquired than genetic dystonia, but the potentially confounding influence of dystonia severity could not be excluded. The aperiodic exponent was not associated with severity or aetiology. Conclusion: Pallidal LFP markers are associated with dystonia severity in children, with delta peak power, low-gamma peak power and pallidopallidal coherence reflecting clinically relevant features of disease expression. These findings highlight the potential of pallidal LFPs to characterise dystonia across the lifespan and motivate longitudinal studies of their developmental and clinical trajectories.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：基底节活动异常是肌张力障碍病理生理学的关键特征，但证据主要基于成人队列。发育期的神经生理特征仍知之甚少。双向神经刺激器记录到的局部场电位（LFPs）提供了苍白球内侧部（GPi）活动的直接测量。在一项横断面儿童队列中，我们研究了苍白球振荡、非周期性和连接性特征是否与肌张力障碍严重程度相关，以及这些特征在遗传性和获得性肌张力障碍之间是否存在差异。方法：我们招募了30名患有药物难治性肌张力障碍的儿童和年轻成人（5-20岁）（遗传性 n = 10；获得性 n = 20），他们接受了双侧GPi脑深部电刺激（DBS）植入。使用Medtronic Percept RC神经刺激器在刺激关闭状态下、DBS激活前记录10分钟的苍白球LFPs，并在可获得的情况下于12个月时记录。在delta（1-4 Hz）、theta（4-8 Hz）、alpha（8-13 Hz）、beta（13-30 Hz）和低gamma（30-45 Hz）频段量化了频谱功率、非周期指数和半球间苍白球-苍白球相干性。采用线性混合效应模型确定LFP标志物是否能预测肌张力障碍严重程度，以Burke-Fahn-Marsden肌张力障碍评定量表（BFMDRS-运动）测量。Firth偏差校正逻辑回归评估LFP标志物是否能预测肌张力障碍病因。结果：频谱峰值在delta、beta和低gamma频段最一致地被检测到。Delta和低gamma峰值功率显著预测肌张力障碍严重程度。这种关联独立于药物负担、结构性GPi受累和肌张力障碍病因。Theta和alpha峰值检测一致性较低，其功率与肌张力障碍严重程度无关。苍白球-苍白球相干性在所有频段中与药物负荷交互作用显著预测肌张力障碍严重程度。获得性肌张力障碍的低gamma峰值功率显著低于遗传性肌张力障碍，但不能排除肌张力障碍严重程度的潜在混杂影响。非周期指数与严重程度或病因无关。结论：苍白球LFP标志物与儿童肌张力障碍严重程度相关，其中delta峰值功率、低gamma峰值功率和苍白球-苍白球相干性反映了疾病表达的临床相关特征。这些发现凸显了苍白球LFPs在跨生命周期表征肌张力障碍方面的潜力，并推动对其发育和临床轨迹的纵向研究。

papers.title: inClinico Agent for clinical trial endpoint prediction and prospective evaluation
papers.translated_title: inClinico智能体用于临床试验终点预测与前瞻性评估
papers.author: Chen, J.
papers.summary: High attrition rates across clinical drug development impose immense clinical and financial burdens, yet prospectively forecasting whether an individual trial will achieve its primary endpoint remains challenging. Here we present a machine-learning system that predicts clinical trial success across phases I-IV, independently modeling studies with efficacy versus safety/toxicity primary endpoints. To prevent lookahead bias and outcome leakage, models are trained on registration-time features, including target and mechanism-of-action precedent, drug modality and novelty, trial design and operational characteristics, and frozen literature-derived target-choice embeddings. Each prediction yields a continuous Predictive Trial Index (PTI) between 0 and 1 reflecting success probability. On a test set of trials initiated in 2021 or later, the efficacy model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.828 (95% CI 0.812-0.845; n = 2,347) and the safety/toxicity model reached 0.809 (95% CI 0.787-0.831; n = 1,485). These models are embedded in inClinico Agent, an agentic AI system integrating frontier large language models (LLMs) with deterministic scoring engines, retrieval tools and specialized clinical skills. We also introduce ClinicoBench, a prospective benchmark of 3,235 ongoing trials evaluated by inClinico Agent and five frontier LLMs, establishing a leakage-free foundation for tracking prospective predictive accuracy as trials reach completion.
papers.translated_summary: 临床试验药物开发中的高流失率带来了巨大的临床和经济负担，然而前瞻性预测单个试验能否达到其主要终点仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一个机器学习系统，可预测I-IV期临床试验的成功率，并分别对以疗效为主要终点和以安全性/毒性为主要终点的研究进行独立建模。为防止前视偏差和结果泄漏，模型基于注册时特征进行训练，包括靶点和作用机制的先例、药物模态和新颖性、试验设计和操作特征，以及冻结的文献衍生靶点选择嵌入。每个预测产生一个介于0和1之间的连续预测试验指数（PTI），反映成功概率。在2021年或之后启动的试验测试集上，疗效模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）达到0.828（95% CI 0.812-0.845；n = 2,347），安全性/毒性模型达到0.809（95% CI 0.787-0.831；n = 1,485）。这些模型嵌入于inClinico Agent中，这是一个代理式AI系统，整合了前沿大型语言模型（LLMs）与确定性评分引擎、检索工具和专业化临床技能。我们还引入了ClinicoBench，这是一个由inClinico Agent和五个前沿LLMs评估的3,235项正在进行试验的前瞻性基准，为在试验完成时跟踪前瞻性预测准确性建立了无泄漏的基础。

papers.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists (GLP-1RAs) for treatment of tobacco and alcohol dependence: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
papers.translated_title: GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）用于治疗烟草和酒精依赖：随机对照试验的系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Taylor, G.
papers.summary: Background Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) might reduce tobacco and alcohol use. We synthesised evidence from randomised controlled trials (RCTs) on smoking and alcohol outcomes, including secondary outcomes reported in trials conducted for other clinical purposes. Methods We searched MEDLINE, Embase, PsycINFO, Web of Science, CENTRAL, PubMed, and registries for RCTs comparing GLP-1RAs with placebo from inception to August 18, 2026. Smoking and alcohol outcomes were synthesised using random-effects meta-analyses. We assessed risk of bias (RoB) with RoB-2, and certainty of evidence with the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach. Findings Fourteen trials involving 1149 participants were included; 13 contributed to meta-analyses. Across the 14 trials, 8 recruited participants not seeking either tobacco or alcohol treatment. The other 6 recruited treatment-seeking participants: 3 for tobacco and 3 for alcohol. Eight trials reported smoking-related outcomes, 11 reported alcohol outcomes, and 5 reported both. Follow-up ranged from 6 to 60 weeks. All 4 pooled smoking-related estimates favoured GLP-1RAs, although all 95% CIs included no difference and were compatible with increases and decreases in outcomes; e.g., smoking cessation, OR 1.39 (95% CI, 0.77 to 2.53, k=3). Restricting analyses to semaglutide trials indicated a reduction in cigarettes per day (CPD) (SMD=-0.10, 95%CI:-0.16 to -0.04; k=3). Across agents, pooled estimates favoured GLP-1RAs for days without alcohol (SMD=0.35, 95%CI: 0.12 to 0.59, k=3). Pooled estimates of semaglutide-only trials also favoured treatment for alcohol consumption (grams/day; SMD=-0.56, 95%CI:-0.82 to -0.30; k=2), craving (SMD=-0.60, 95%CI:-0.91 to -0.29; k=2), drinks per drinking day (SMD=-0.59, 95%CI:-0.86 to -0.32; k=3), drinks per calendar day (SMD=-0.48, 95%CI:-0.87 to -0.09; k=2) and heavy drinking days (SMD=-0.45, 95%CI:-0.85 to -0.06; k=3), and alcohol-free days (SMD=0.41, 95%CI:0.09 to 0.73; k=2). Two of 41 assessed results were at low RoB, 31 raised some concerns and 8 were at high risk; certainty was moderate for 1 outcome, low for 4 and very low for 8. Interpretation GLP-1RAs may reduce alcohol consumption and CPD, with the clearest evidence for semaglutide. These findings should be contextualised by most evidence being low- to very-low-certainty. Larger trials are needed to establish clinically meaningful benefit and sustained abstinence.

papers.title: Cumulative Prenatal Adversity and Fronto-Limbic White Matter Development Across Adolescence
papers.translated_title: 累积产前逆境与青春期前额-边缘系统白质发育
papers.author: Costello, L. A.
papers.summary: Importance: The prenatal period is a critical window for intergenerational transmission of adversity, yet the neural substrates through which cumulative prenatal stress becomes biologically embedded in offspring brain development remain poorly understood. White matter microstructure is a candidate mechanism linking prenatal adversity to downstream emotional dysregulation. Objective: To examine associations between cumulative adverse prenatal exposure (APE) burden and fronto-limbic white matter fractional anisotropy (FA) at baseline and across adolescent developmental trajectories, and to test whether white matter FA mediates prenatal APE effects on emotional dysregulation. Design, Setting, and Participants: Cohort study using data from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, Release 7.0, a diverse longitudinal cohort of US children recruited at ages 9 to 10 years across 21 sites. After diffusion tensor imaging quality control exclusions and retention of one twin or triplet per family, the final cross-sectional analytic sample comprised 10 483 participants. Longitudinal analyses included participants with data at one or more follow-up timepoints across four imaging waves. Exposures: Cumulative APE burden, operationalized as a sum of six binary adverse prenatal exposures (unplanned pregnancy; early alcohol, tobacco, and cannabis use before pregnancy recognition; complicated pregnancy; complicated birth; range, 0-6) following Zhi et al. (2026). Main Outcomes and Measures: Fractional anisotropy in 11 a priori fronto-limbic white matter tracts at baseline (ages approximately 10 years) and across four imaging timepoints (ages approximately 10, 12, 14, and 16 years). Exploratory outcomes included Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL) dysregulation profile and Emotion Regulation Questionnaire (ERQ) subscales. Results: Higher prenatal APE burden was associated with lower baseline FA in left uncinate fasciculus (b = -0.00096; 95% CI, -0.00151 to -0.00042; FDR-corrected P = .006), corpus callosum (b = -0.00079; 95% CI, -0.00125 to -0.00032; FDR-corrected P = .006), and right uncinate fasciculus (b = -0.00071; 95% CI, -0.00120 to -0.00021; FDR-corrected P = .019). These associations were robust to adjustment for diffusion image quality, and prenatal burden was not associated with baseline image quality. In repeated-measures models across four imaging timepoints, higher APE burden was associated with steeper FA increases across adolescence (positive APE x Age interaction in 5 of 11 tracts; positive across all 11), though these trajectory effects were attenuated after adjustment for image quality. Post hoc analyses indicated that pregnancy complications and prenatal cannabis exposure were the most consistent contributors to these associations. White matter FA partially mediated the association between prenatal APE burden and involuntary emotional dysregulation, with no association with voluntary emotion regulation strategies. Conclusions and Relevance: Cumulative prenatal APE burden was associated with lower fronto-limbic white matter FA at the start of adolescence, an association that was stable across development and robust to image-quality adjustment. Evidence for altered developmental trajectories was more sensitive to image quality and should be interpreted cautiously. These findings identify fronto-limbic white matter-- particularly the uncinate fasciculus and corpus callosum-- as a candidate neurobiological correlate of cumulative prenatal adversity, while underscoring that this pathway reflects a bounded set of prenatal exposures.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：产前阶段是逆境代际传递的关键窗口，然而累积产前应激通过何种神经基质在子代大脑发育中实现生物学嵌入仍知之甚少。白质微结构是连接产前逆境与下游情绪失调的候选机制。目的：检验累积产前不良暴露（APE）负担与基线及青少年发育轨迹中额-边缘系统白质各向异性分数（FA）之间的关联，并检验白质FA是否中介产前APE对情绪失调的影响。设计、设置与参与者：队列研究，使用青少年大脑认知发展（ABCD）研究7.0版数据，该研究为美国儿童多样性纵向队列，在21个站点于9至10岁招募。经弥散张量成像质量控制排除及每家庭保留一名双胎或三胎之一后，最终横断面分析样本包括10 483名参与者。纵向分析纳入在四个成像波次中一个或多个随访时间点有数据的参与者。暴露：累积APE负担，依据Zhi等（2026）操作化为六项二元产前不良暴露之和（非计划妊娠；确认妊娠前早期饮酒、吸烟和大麻使用；妊娠并发症；分娩并发症；范围0-6）。主要结局与测量：基线（约10岁）及四个成像时间点（约10、12、14和16岁）11条先验额-边缘系统白质纤维束的各向异性分数。探索性结局包括儿童行为量表（CBCL）失调剖面和情绪调节问卷（ERQ）各分量表。结果：较高的产前APE负担与左侧钩束基线FA较低相关（b = -0.00096；95% CI，-0.00151至-0.00042；FDR校正P = .006）、胼胝体（b = -0.00079；95% CI，-0.00125至-0.00032；FDR校正P = .006）及右侧钩束（b = -0.00071；95% CI，-0.00120至-0.00021；FDR校正P = .019）。这些关联对弥散图像质量调整稳健，且产前负担与基线图像质量无关。在四个成像时间点的重复测量模型中，较高APE负担与青春期FA更陡峭的增加相关（11条纤维束中5条存在正向APE×年龄交互作用；全部11条均为正向），尽管这些轨迹效应在图像质量调整后减弱。事后分析表明，妊娠并发症和产前大麻暴露是这些关联最一致的贡献因素。白质FA部分中介产前APE负担与不随意情绪失调之间的关联，而与随意情绪调节策略无关联。结论与意义：累积产前APE负担与青春期开始时额-边缘系统白质FA较低相关，该关联在整个发育过程中稳定且对图像质量调整稳健。发育轨迹改变的证据对图像质量更为敏感，应谨慎解读。这些发现确定额-边缘系统白质——尤其是钩束和胼胝体——为累积产前逆境的候选神经生物学相关因素，同时强调该通路反映的是一组有限的产前暴露。

papers.title: Carbapenem Resistance Among Gram-Negative Bacteria in Bioaerosols at Biomedical Waste Disposal Site in Ahmedabad, India
papers.translated_title: 印度艾哈迈达巴德生物医学废物处置场生物气溶胶中革兰氏阴性菌的碳青霉烯类耐药性
papers.author: BARAI, R. S.
papers.summary: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a global public health concern, with Gram-negative carbapenem-resistant bacteria (CRG) classified by WHO as critical priority pathogens. Biomedical waste disposal sites (BMWs) may act as reservoirs for resistant organisms, posing occupational and community risks. This study investigated the phenotypic and genotypic characterization of Gram-negative carbapenem-resistant bacteria in bioaerosols collected from BMW facilities in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Bioaerosols were sampled using active Six-stage Andersen Impactors and passive settled plates. Isolates were identified by MALDI-TOF, followed by antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST). Whole genome sequencing (WGS) was performed for 26 representative isolates, and resistance gene profiling was conducted using CARD and ResFinder databases. Representative isolates belonged to Moraxellaceae, Enterobacteriaceae, and Pseudomonadaceae families. All species showed resistance to linezolid, and approximately 60% were multidrug resistant to carbapenems, cephalosporins, and fluoroquinolones. Genotypic analysis confirmed the prevalence of carbapenemase genes, with blaNDM-1 most frequent, followed by blaNDM-7, blaVIM-2, blaVIM-11, blaOXA-23, and blaOXA-235. This is the first report documenting Acinetobacter baumannii, A. schindleri, A. towneri, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Pseudomonas juntendi in bioaerosols from BMW sites. Biomedical waste environments serve as critical reservoirs of AMR. These findings emphasize the need for surveillance, protective measures, and integration of environmental AMR monitoring into public health policy.
papers.translated_summary: 抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）是全球公共卫生关注的问题，革兰阴性碳青霉烯耐药细菌（CRG）被世界卫生组织列为关键优先级病原体。生物医学废物处置场所（BMWs）可能成为耐药微生物的储存库，带来职业和社区风险。本研究调查了从印度古吉拉特邦艾哈迈达巴德生物医学废物设施收集的生物气溶胶中革兰阴性碳青霉烯耐药细菌的表型和基因型特征。生物气溶胶采用主动式六级Andersen撞击器和被动沉降平板采样。分离株通过MALDI-TOF鉴定，随后进行抗菌药物敏感性试验（AST）。对26株代表性分离株进行了全基因组测序（WGS），并使用CARD和ResFinder数据库进行耐药基因谱分析。代表性分离株属于莫拉菌科、肠杆菌科和假单胞菌科。所有菌种均对利奈唑胺表现出耐药性，约60%对碳青霉烯类、头孢菌素类和氟喹诺酮类多重耐药。基因型分析证实了碳青霉烯酶基因的流行，其中blaNDM-1最为常见，其次为blaNDM-7、blaVIM-2、blaVIM-11、blaOXA-23和blaOXA-235。这是首次报道在生物医学废物场所的生物气溶胶中检出鲍曼不动杆菌、A. schindleri、A. towneri、肺炎克雷伯菌和Pseudomonas juntendi。生物医学废物环境是AMR的重要储存库。这些发现强调了监测、防护措施以及将环境AMR监测纳入公共卫生政策的必要性。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Writing Across Medical Journals: Heterogeneity in Prevalence and Trends
papers.translated_title: AI辅助写作在医学期刊中的差异：流行率与趋势的异质性
papers.author: Flanders, M. D.
papers.summary: Background: Estimates of generative artificial intelligence (AI) use in the medical literature vary widely, potentially reflecting differences across journals. We estimated changes in the prevalence of AI-generated writing over time using abstracts from 12 general medical journals. Methods: We randomly sampled up to 200 abstracts per journal-year from publications dated January 1, 2020, through August 8, 2026. Abstracts were scored using GPTZero, with journal-specific thresholds calibrated to fix a 1% false-positive rate (FPR) in the pre-AI baseline period (2020-2021). We estimated annual detector-positive proportions and calculated a publication-volume-weighted estimate across sampled journals. Associations with journal impact factor, publication model, and publication volume were examined descriptively. Results: Among 15,268 abstracts, estimated prevalence of AI-generated text increased after 2022, with substantial variation in timing and magnitude across journals. In 2026 through August 8, prevalence estimates ranged from 5.7% (95% CI, 2.1%-10.0%) in the New England Journal of Medicine to 83.5% (95% CI, 77.1%-87.5%) in Frontiers in Medicine. The publication-volume-weighted estimate across sampled journals was 66.7% (95% CI, 64.0%-69.2%), and trends were insensitive to specification of false-positive rate in baseline data. The proportion of abstracts showing signs of AI-generated text was lower in journals with higher impact factors and higher in fully open-access journals. Conclusions: Estimated prevalence of AI-generated text increased substantially across all sampled medical journals, with marked between-journal differences associated with journal impact factor and publication model. These findings support development of standardized, transparent AI reporting in medical publishing.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：医学文献中生成式人工智能（AI）使用率的估计差异很大，可能反映了不同期刊之间的差异。我们利用12种综合医学期刊的摘要，估计了AI生成写作的流行率随时间的变化。方法：我们从2020年1月1日至2026年8月8日发表的论文中，每个期刊-年份随机抽取最多200篇摘要。使用GPTZero对摘要进行评分，并采用期刊特异性阈值进行校准，以在AI出现前的基线期（2020-2021年）将假阳性率（FPR）固定为1%。我们估计了年度检测器阳性比例，并计算了跨抽样期刊的发表量加权估计值。对与期刊影响因子、出版模式和发表量的关联进行了描述性分析。结果：在15,268篇摘要中，估计的AI生成文本流行率在2022年后上升，各期刊在时间趋势和幅度上存在显著差异。在2026年至8月8日期间，流行率估计值从New England Journal of Medicine的5.7%（95% CI，2.1%-10.0%）到Frontiers in Medicine的83.5%（95% CI，77.1%-87.5%）不等。跨抽样期刊的发表量加权估计值为66.7%（95% CI，64.0%-69.2%），且趋势对基线数据中假阳性率的设定不敏感。在影响因子较高的期刊中，显示AI生成文本迹象的摘要比例较低，而在完全开放获取期刊中较高。结论：在所有抽样医学期刊中，估计的AI生成文本流行率大幅上升，期刊间差异显著，且与期刊影响因子和出版模式相关。这些发现支持在医学出版中制定标准化、透明的AI报告规范。
